senses.gloss: m. (שָׁכַן; v. Del. Assyr. Handw. s. v. שכן) establishment, realization, execution; use of the phrase כן עשה.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 6:22">Gen. VI, 22</cite>) <he>זה ש׳ לעשיית התיבה</he> this refers to the carrying out of the command to make the ark; <cite ref="Genesis 6:22">ib.</cite> s. 32 (ref. to ib. VII, 5 <he>ויעש … ככל וכ׳</he>) <he>זה ש׳ לכינוס בהמה</he> this refers to the execution of the command to bring in the beasts; Yalk. ib. 55; 56 <he>שכיון</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 8:20">Gen. VIII, 20</cite> a.

<cite ref="Genesis 9:1">IX, 1</cite>) <he>זה ש׳ לזכות הקרבנות</he> (not <he>שיכן בזכות</he>) this is an establishment (standard passage, cmp. <he>בנין אב</he>, s. v. <cite ref="A00017"><he>אָב</he></cite>) of the reward of sacrifices.
